name: edge
description: A network's edge: the gateway, the relay, the presigner, the web client's files, the public MCP endpoint for a sharing link's holder, and each plugin's part there.

scripts.types: wrangler types -c relay/wrangler.jsonc -c presigner/wrangler.jsonc relay/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --env-interface RelayEnv && wrangler types -c presigner/wrangler.jsonc presigner/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --env-interface PresignerEnv && wrangler types -c public-mcp/wrangler.jsonc -c relay/wrangler.jsonc -c presigner/wrangler.jsonc public-mcp/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --env-interface PublicMcpEnv
